name: claude-mods
description: Ango Media's mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: imessage-chat
plugins.description: Draws the chat as iMessage-style bubbles: yours in blue on the right, Claude's in a softer blue on the left

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: A card above the message box with the model, effort, context window, usage limits and their reset times, cost and session length

plugins.name: typing-bubble
plugins.description: Replaces the working spinner with iMessage's typing bubble: three dots pulsing in a gray bubble while Claude works

plugins.name: done-chime
plugins.description: Plays iMessage's tone when Claude finishes a reply or asks you something, so you can look away while it works

plugins.name: turn-summary
plugins.description: Sums up each reply: how long it took, how many tools Claude used, and which files changed by how many lines

plugins.name: text-expander
plugins.description: Type a short code like ;;t and it becomes a full prompt when you send it. Manage them in a two-column window with /snippets

plugins.name: files-changed
plugins.description: A side pane listing every file Claude changed this session, with lines added and removed. Click one to open it

plugins.name: break-reminder
plugins.description: A countdown to your next break under the message box, and a gentle reminder after 50 minutes of work. Time away counts as a break

plugins.name: project-notes
plugins.description: A notes pane for each project: a checklist you add to, tick off and keep between sessions, saved as a plain Markdown file

plugins.name: screenshot-attach
plugins.description: Type ;;ss in a message (or ;;ss3 for three) and your latest screenshots go with it, so you never have to drag them in
